facts.title: hpscore
facts.tagline: letter-scale score of an ink map against a segment's labels
facts.success: Exit code 0 and a non-null, non-NaN `forward.hp_r`.
facts.not_a_pass: A forward `hp_r` with no control; a forward `hp_r` at or below `control.hp_r` or `forward.null_max_abs`; a comparison of two maps made at different blur; any comparison with ShribyrLabs' numbers; a score on a segment the model trained on; a map of logits (negatives are left out).
facts.never: Call a letter-scale score a reading or say letters were found; treat it as a legibility bar; pass a `--voxel-um` other than the map's pixel size.
